policy.development: One post-freeze scoring pass; reused development set from prior work, not a new holdout. Independent checks use saved outputs.
policy.generation: Temperature1; six methods x2terminals x32requests=384; no oracle length, no rejection, no replenishment; identical integer seeds across methods but torch/Python RNG streams differ

inherited_metric_formulas.ar_nll: teacher-forced diagnostic reported separately; not comparable with VAE objective
inherited_metric_formulas.claims: no activity, wetlab validation, significance, novelty, general method superiority or submission-readiness claim
inherited_metric_formulas.engineering_prerequisite: screens require complete request execution here and independently verified fixed-step training/budget upstream
inherited_metric_formulas.feature_blocks: length/48,20 AA fractions,400 dipeptide fractions; each scaled by 1/sqrt(3)
inherited_metric_formulas.macro: mean recall over amino-acid classes supported by target; PAD excluded
inherited_metric_formulas.missing_prediction: counts incorrect at every unrendered target position; never removes truth denominator
inherited_metric_formulas.mmd: biased linear MMD squared on 421 frozen features; valid canonical 1..48 only
inherited_metric_formulas.reconstruction: posterior mean only; rendered sequence aligned to target positions; no nearest-neighbor truth
inherited_metric_formulas.scope: exploratory single-fit train/development pilot; no test access
inherited_metric_formulas.uncertainty: no p-values/CI; draws are not independent training replicates; development has been reused

policy.primary: Frozen predictive full sequence conditional NLL: every residue from BOS and first EOS iff length<48, no extra EOS at cap48; terminal means and equal terminal mean
policy.secondary: Token NLL, AA/EOS NLL; all unfiltered generation validity, EOS/cap, lengths, frozen MMD, AA/dipeptide JS, exact copy, nearest identity, entropy
